title: Kaafiron Ki Namaaz
text:
Kaafiron Ki Namaaz (transl. Prayer of non-believers) is  a 2016 Hindi-language drama film written and directed by Ram Ramesh Sharma. The film won four awards including the Best Feature Film at the third Ladakh International Film Festival. 
Unable to get censor clearance for a theatrical release, the film was released on YouTube on 7 April 2016.
